gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-roboto: Coming Soon writes like a quick note, its o a single ring of unchanging wall thickness you could trace with a fingertip. Roboto follows in tidy sans-serif form, its round letters opening generously beside that loose hand.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-ruda: Ruda reads like a plain sans with a sizable x-height and a wire-thin skeleton, its rounded lowercase wide open at the mouth. Yet the real draw is the handwritten Coming Soon above it, casual and personal against that tidy line.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-saira: Scribbled warmth meets crisp structure here. Saira keeps its s open enough to see through, so text runs smoothly under Coming Soon, whose hairline joins give way to full-width strokes.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-sarpanch: Coming Soon looks scrawled with a stylus held at fixed pressure, casual and personal in every letter. Sarpanch sits beneath it as a sans with a clearly open e and compact ascenders, giving the handwriting a tidy, modern anchor.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-savate: Savate is a plain sans with sturdy hairlines and generous curves. Its mild stress keeps every stroke solid, so a long passage moves along smoothly beneath the monoweight, pen-and-paper loops of Coming Soon.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Coming Soon looks like rope-thin handwriting, with no thick or thin parts. Schibsted Grotesk follows with big open e and a shapes and terminals that never close in, so long text stays inviting.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-scope-one: Loose handwriting, then sturdy type. Coming Soon bends its constant-width strokes like pipe, and it earns its keep big and short, while Scope One's open counters and stubby ascenders carry the traditional text below.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-sen: Casual is the mood of Coming Soon, whose lowercase climbs close to the capitals with a personal hand. Yet Sen holds its own as a plain sans, tall and traced in a single constant line.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-slabo-13px: A plain, unshaded line that never swells gives Coming Soon its homemade charm. Slabo 13px settles in beneath as a text serif with large open counters, so a long passage feels bookish and easy to follow.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-sofia-sans: Sofia Sans stands tall and modern, with no thick-and-thin modulation and rounded letters clearly open at the side. Over a long passage, Sofia Sans feels like cut acrylic pieces lined up, while Coming Soon adds casual handwriting above.
